title: NodeGX — what's new
description: Release notes shown in the NodeGX editor. An empty items list means there is nothing to announce; the editor treats that as a normal state and opens no modal.

items.title: NodeGX 0.4.0
items.content_html:
NodeGX 0.4.0

Your project is updated to a newer format the first time you open it. NodeGX first copies the project folder to <project>.before-0.4 and tells you where the copy is. Keep that copy until you're happy with the updated project. It's the only copy 0.3.0 can still open.

Apps made with npm create nodegx open in the editor.

Functions can share code through script files. Scripts have their own section in the Components panel.

A node can explain itself. How this node works, under the node's name in the properties panel, opens a window where you read what the node does and try it.

Everything in 0.4.0
